description: Generate audio: speech, multi-character dialogue, sound effects, and background music from one prompt (Seed Audio 1.0 by default; plain text-to-speech available). Voice cloning takes hosted reference clip URLs in audio_urls; local audio files are not accepted. Returns an audio URL, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status.

audio_urls.description: seed-audio only: up to 3 hosted reference clips (wav, mp3, pcm or ogg_opus, 30s / 10MB max each) for voice cloning, referenced in the prompt as @Audio1..@Audio3. Local audio files cannot be uploaded; pass URLs. Ignored by text-to-speech.

model.description: seed-audio (default): speech, multi-voice dialogue, effects and music in one clip, and voice cloning from audio_urls. text-to-speech: plain narration with preset voices.

output_format.description: Output format. seed-audio: mp3 (default), wav, pcm, ogg_opus. text-to-speech: mp3 (default), wav, flac, pcm.

prompt.description: seed-audio: a script to speak, or a scene description (dialogue, sound effects, music), up to 2048 characters; refer to audio_urls clips in order as @Audio1..@Audio3. text-to-speech: the exact text to speak, up to 10,000 characters.

voice.description: text-to-speech only: voice preset (e.g. Wise_Woman, Calm_Woman, Friendly_Person; default Wise_Woman). seed-audio ignores it: describe the voice in the prompt, or clone one with audio_urls.

name: pixeldojo_audio
title: Generate music, speech or sound
